name: Anjali Ramaswamy
situation: Anjali is 28, a fourth-year PhD student in hydrology at the University of Utah in Salt Lake City. Her dissertation models how earlier snowmelt in the Wasatch Range changes late-summer streamflow. She teaches a lab section, applies for fellowships, and runs field trips to her snow sensor sites.
domains: dissertation research: data, models and code
writing chapters, papers and fellowship applications
fieldwork at the snow sensor sites
grad school life, money and plans after the PhD
agent_role: Her research and writing assistant: it helps debug her Python and R code, reads and summarizes papers, tracks deadlines and committee feedback, and keeps notes on her experiments.
voice: Precise and slightly anxious, with lots of parentheses; she writes in bursts late at night.
agent_voice: Careful and academic: hedges where the data is thin, cites papers by first author and year, suggests the next check to run.
